K. H. M. Sajith P. Kasthurisinghe, Returning Officer, Embilipitiya Urban Council. District Elections Office, Ratnapura, 22nd of June 2026. texts.gazette-2494-03: ශ්‍රී ලංංකාා ප්‍රජාාතාාන්ත්‍රිකා සමාාජාවාාදී ජානරජායේ� ගැැසට් පත්‍රය අති වියේ�ෂ The Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka EXTRAORDINARY අංකා 2494/03 - 2026 ජුනි මාස 22 වාැනි සඳුදාා - 2026.06.22 No. 2494/03 - MONDAY, JUNE 22, 2026 (Published by Authority) PART IV (B) — LOCAL GOVERNMENT Notices under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance FILLING OF A VACANCY IN THE OFFICE OF MEMBER OF THE WELIGAMA PRADESHIYA SABHA UNDER SECTION 66A(1)(a) OF THE LOCAL AUTHORITIES ELECTIONS ORDINANCE (CHAPTER 262) WHEREAS the Office of a member of the Weligama Pradeshiya Sabha has fallen vacant by reason of Death ; And whereas the Secretary of the Jathika Jana Balawegaya, the recognized political party to which Mr. Liyanage Rohana Kumara Lamahewa the member who belonged, was required by me under Section 66A(1)(a) of the aforesaid Ordinance, to nominate a candidate of that ward Number 25 Thalaramba of Weligama Pradeshiya Sabha who belongs to such party and who is not disqualified under Section 9 of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance (Chapter 262) and who shall be declared Elected as a member within a period of thirty (30) days; And whereas the Secretary of the aforesaid recognized political party has communicated the decision to nominate Mr. Gangabada Arachchige Noman Chandrika to fill the said vacancy; Therefore I, Pulasthi Serasingha Pathirana, Returning Officer of the Weligama Pradeshiya Sabha, acting in terms of Section 66A(l)(a) of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance (Chapter 262), do hereby declare that Mr. Gangabada Arachchige Noman Chandrika was elected as the member of the ward number 25 Thalaramba of the Weligama Pradeshiya Sabha. P. S. Pathirana, Returning Officer, Weligama Pradeshiya Sabha. District Election Office, Matara, 22nd June, 2026. EOG 06 – 0258 1A - PG 7764 - 04 (06/2026) PRINTED AT THE DEPARTMENT OF GOVERNMENT PRINTING, SRI LANKA. This Gazette Extraordinary can be downloaded from www.documents.gov.lk
texts.gazette-2494-07: ශ්‍රී ලංංකාා ප්‍රජාාතාාන්ත්‍රිකා සමාාජාවාාදී ජානරජායේ� ගැැසට් පත්‍රය අති වියේ�ෂ The Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka EXTRAORDINARY අංකා 2494/07 - 2026 ජුනි මාස 23 වාැනි අඟහරුවාාදාා - 2026.06.23 No. 2494/07 - TUESDAY, JUNE 23, 2026 (Published by Authority) PART IV (B) — LOCAL GOVERNMENT Notices under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance FILLING OF A VACANCY IN THE OFFICE OF MEMBER OF THE JA - ELA PRADESHIYA SABHA UNDER SECTION 66A(1)(b) OF THE LOCAL AUTHORITIES ELECTIONS ORDINANCE (CHAPTER 262) WHEREAS the Office of a returned member of the Ja - Ela Pradeshiya Sabha has fallen vacant by reason of death ; And whereas the Secretary of the Sarvajana Balaya, the recognized political Party to which Mr. Bolanda Devage Thusitha Kumara Wijayarathna the member belonged, was required by me under Section 66A(1)(b) of the aforesaid Ordinance, to decide upon a candidate of the Ja - Ela Pradeshiya Sabha who belongs to such party and who is not disqualified under Section 9 of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance (Chapter 262) and who shall be declared Elected as a member within a period of thirty (30) days; And whereas the Secretary of the aforesaid recognized political party has communicated the decision to nominate Mr. Alagiyadura Dulip Ravindra Fernando to fill the said vacancy; Therefore I, Withana Appuhamilage Raviendra Wickramasinghe, Returning Officer of the Ja - Ela Pradeshiya Sabha, acting in terms of Section 66A(l)(b) of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance (Chapter 262) do hereby declare that Mr. Alagiyadura Dulip Ravindra Fernando was elected as the member of the Ja - Ela Pradeshiya Sabha. W. A. Raviendra Wickramasinghe, Returning Officer, Ja - Ela Pradeshiya Sabha. District Elections Office, Gampaha, 23rd of June, 2026. EOG 06 – 0264 1A - PG 7769 - 04 (06/2026) PRINTED AT THE DEPARTMENT OF GOVERNMENT PRINTING, SRI LANKA. This Gazette Extraordinary can be downloaded from www.documents.gov.lk
